verdicts.reason: Both put '$3' above '2 FOR', so the offer reads backwards, and both shrink the FIZZBANG logo to an illegible pill. A jams the can against the left edge, strands the CTA and logo far right, and leaves big dead gaps. B is worse because the CTA, logo and body copy are crammed into one run along the bottom edge, with the copy butting the logo and the can floating off to the side.
